newsitem.title: USA: Chock Full o'Nuts profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Chock Full o'Nuts profits rise.

text.p: Coffee roaster and marketer Chock Full o'Nuts Corp. said Thursday its earnings rose about 26 percent in its fiscal second quarter.

The New York-based company said its earning from continuing operations rose to $1.75 million, or 16 cents a share, from $1.39 million, or 13 cents a share, a year ago. The year-ago results included a loss from discontinued operations of $444,000, or 4 cents per share.
Sales rose to $84.2 million from $82.2 million.
The stock of the company, which makes regular, instant and decaffeinated coffee, was off 12.5 cents at $5.75 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
